title: ConfigFile
description: Resolved CLI configuration, including defaults and environment overrides.

custom_provider.description:
Active custom provider id (ROADMAP §D2). When set, this overrides
`provider` and selects the matching `[[providers.custom]]` entry by id.
The host maps this to `ProviderId::Custom(id)` for `resolve_llm_client`.

turn_executor.description:
Selected main-turn executor id (kernel composition,
`engine::executor_composition`). Kept as a raw string because the id
space is open: the always-present `builtin` plus any factory a host
registers on the process-shared turn-executor registry. An unknown id
fails loud at startup.

http_headers.description: Optional extra HTTP headers sent to model API requests.

reasoning_effort.description:
DeepSeek reasoning-effort tier: `"off" | "low" | "medium" | "high" | "max"`.
Defaults to `"max"` at runtime if unset.

tools.description:
Native tool catalog controls. `tools_file` is the legacy external
schema path; this table controls built-in tool loading policy.

strict_tool_mode.description:
When true, set `tool_choice: "required"` and opt compatible function
schemas into DeepSeek beta strict mode. Schemas with root alternatives
stay non-strict to avoid changing optional/one-of tool semantics.

instructions.description:
Additional system-prompt sources concatenated in declared order
(#454). Paths are expanded via `expand_path` so `~` and env
vars work. Project config overrides user config (replace, not
merge) — that's the typical "this repo needs X plus everything
I already have" pattern, where users put `~/global.md` in the
project's array if they want both. Each file is loaded, capped
at 100 KiB, and skipped (with a warning) on read errors so a
missing optional file doesn't fail the launch.

system_prompt.description:
Full system prompt override. Replaces the built-in assembled prompt but
still preserves explicit append sections after it.

system_prompt_file.description: Path to a file containing the full system prompt override.

append_system_prompt.description: Additional system-prompt append sources rendered after the selected base.

personality.description:
Personality overlay for the system prompt: `"calm"` (default) or
`"playful"`. Case-insensitive; invalid values fail `validate` at
startup so typos surface immediately instead of silently falling
back to calm. Presentation-only — voice and tone, never behavior.

preset.description:
Active configuration preset tier (`simple` | `middle` | `all` |
`experiment`, plus `plan` and user/project preset files). Preset
values are *baselines* applied fill-if-unset after profile and
project merging: explicit keys elsewhere in this file always win,
and any explicit value that differs from the selected tier turns
the effective preset into `diy` (a derived state — see
[`Config::effective_preset`]). Overridden by `--preset` on the CLI.

mode.description:
Deprecated pre-rename alias of [`Self::preset`]; still accepted so
existing configs keep working (canonicalized with a warning).

telemetry.description:
Enable local-only telemetry: capacity-decision analytics events are
written to `~/.codesmith/telemetry/events.jsonl`. Off by default; the
sink is constructed pre-trust (events queue in-memory) and only
attaches (writes to disk) once the workspace trust boundary passes.

telemetry_otlp.description:
OTLP/HTTP telemetry export (`[telemetry_otlp]`). Opt-in and
default-off: absent table (or empty `url`) means the exporter is
never constructed — zero network. See `docs/CONFIGURATION.md`.

mods.description:
Script Mods (§F script mod layer) controls: `enabled` gates the whole
script-mod layer (discovery, `manage_mods` tool, watcher), `watch`
gates only the hot-reload file watcher. Both default to `true`.
Documented in `config.example.toml` + `docs/MODS.md`.

commands.description:
Built-in slash-command controls (`[commands] disabled`): canonical
names or aliases of builtin commands to hide — dispatch, `/help`,
and Tab completion all skip them, while user commands and mod
commands of the same name still work. Validated against the builtin
table at REPL start (an unknown name fails loud). Documented in
`config.example.toml` + `docs/CLI.md`.

automations.description:
Bounds for scheduled automation runs (`[automations] max_steps`).
Defaults to [`AUTOMATION_DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS`] — see
[`AutomationsConfig`].

sandbox_backend.description:
External sandbox backend: `"none"` or `"opensandbox"`.
When set, exec_shell routes commands through the backend's HTTP API
instead of spawning a local process.

sandbox_url.description: Base URL for the external sandbox backend (default: `"http://localhost:8080"`).

sandbox_api_key.description: Optional API key for the external sandbox backend (sent as Bearer token).

sandbox.description:
Optional structured sandbox controls. Legacy top-level sandbox fields are
still accepted and are merged into the runtime view for compatibility.

prefer_bwrap.description:
When true and `/usr/bin/bwrap` is present on Linux, route exec_shell
through bubblewrap instead of relying solely on Landlock (#2184).
Defaults to false. Requires the `bubblewrap` package to be installed
separately — we do NOT vendor bwrap.

stream_idle_timeout_secs.description:
Idle watchdog for streaming responses, in seconds: the maximum
silence between two consecutive stream events before the stream is
declared silently stalled and aborted into the transparent-retry path
(P0-1). Default 120; `0` disables the watchdog; clamped to
`[MIN_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECS, MAX_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECS]`
(10..=3600) otherwise.

stream_idle_retry_increment_secs.description:
Per-retry widening of the stream idle watchdog window, in seconds:
each transparent retry's idle deadline grows by this amount times the
retries already spent, so a provider silence gap longer than the base
window doesn't kill every retry in the same silent stretch (P0-1
adaptive retry). Default 30; `0` keeps the window fixed; clamped to
`[0, MAX_STREAM_IDLE_RETRY_INCREMENT_SECS]` (600) otherwise.

providers.description: Provider-specific credentials and defaults shared with the `codesmith` facade.

network.description:
Per-domain network policy (#135). When absent, network tools fall back
to a permissive default, matching the old lenient behavior.

verification.description:
Post-turn claim checks (P3-8). When absent, the result claim
verifier runs with its defaults (on).

doctor.description:
`codesmith doctor` LLM fallback layer (P3-8). When absent, the
advisory analysis runs with its default (on, when findings exist
and a client resolves).

skills.description:
Community skill installer settings (#140). When absent, installer
commands fall back to the bundled defaults
([`codesmith_agent_runtime::skills::install::DEFAULT_REGISTRY_URL`] +
[`codesmith_agent_runtime::skills::install::DEFAULT_MAX_SIZE_BYTES`]).

snapshots.description:
Workspace side-git snapshots (#137). Defaults to enabled with 7-day
retention when the table is absent.

edit.description:
File-editing behavior (P0-1 parse gate). Defaults to enabled when
the table is absent.

search.description:
Web search provider configuration. When absent, defaults to DuckDuckGo.
Set `provider` to `bing`, `tavily`, or `bocha` to use those services
instead; Tavily and Bocha also require an `api_key`.

memory.description:
User-level memory file (#489). Default behaviour is **opt-in**:
loading + injection happens only when `[memory] enabled = true` or
`CODESMITH_MEMORY=on` is set.

auto.description:
Tunables for `--model auto` (#1207). When absent, the auto router
keeps its existing balanced behaviour.

lsp.description:
Post-edit LSP diagnostics injection (#136). When absent, the engine
applies the defaults documented in [`LspConfigToml`].

context.description: Append-only layered context management with Flash seam manager (#159).

runtime.description:
Engine recursion limits (`[runtime]` table). When absent, the
documented defaults apply.

workflow.description:
Bounds for the model-writable `workflow` tool (`[workflow]`
table). When absent, the documented defaults apply.

runtime_api.description:
Runtime API server tuning (`codesmith serve --http`). Currently only
hosts the CORS allow-list extension (whalescale#255 / #561). When the
table is absent, the daemon ships with localhost:3000 / localhost:1420
/ tauri://localhost as the only allowed dev origins.

workshop.description:
Workshop / large-tool-output routing (#548). When absent, the global
default threshold of 4 096 tokens applies and routing is active.

vision_model.description: Vision model configuration for the `image_analyze` tool.

utility_model.description:
Utility model configuration — a cheap/fast secondary LLM for background
assists (workshop large-output synthesis, auto-route classification,
Flash seams). When absent, all assists use the main model.

ToolsConfig.description: Model-visible tool catalog controls (`[tools]` table in config.toml).

always_load.description:
Native tool names to keep loaded even when they are outside the small
default core catalog. Unknown names are harmless and simply never match.

progressive_disclosure.description:
Progressive disclosure: withhold the tools that declare `should_defer`
from the request and offer them on demand through `tool_search`. `None`
(key absent) leaves the decision to the active preset's baseline, which
the factory tiers set on for every tier except `simple`.

plugin_dir.description:
Optional directory to scan for plugin tool scripts. Scripts with a
frontmatter header (`# name:`, `# description:`, `# schema:`) are
auto-discovered and registered as tools.

Defaults to `~/.codesmith/tools/` when `None`.

overrides.description:
Per-tool overrides keyed by built-in tool name.
Each override replaces or disables the named tool.

ToolOverride.description: How a user wants to replace or disable a built-in tool.

oneOf.description:
Run a local script file. The script receives the tool's JSON input
on stdin and must return a JSON `ToolResult` on stdout.

path.description: Path to the script (absolute, or relative to `~/.codesmith/tools/`).

args.description: Optional static arguments prepended before the tool's JSON input.

oneOf.description:
Run an external command. The command receives the tool's JSON input
on stdin and must return a JSON `ToolResult` on stdout.

command.description: The command to run (binary name or absolute path).

args.description: Optional static arguments prepended before the tool's JSON input.

oneOf.description:
Completely disable a built-in tool. The tool will not appear in the
model-visible catalog and cannot be called.

TelemetryOtlpConfig.description:
OTLP/HTTP telemetry export (`[telemetry_otlp]` table in config.toml,
P1-2). Opt-in: absent table means no exporter and zero network. Records
are OTLP/HTTP-JSON logs (`<url>/v1/logs`) carrying a stable anonymous
install id — never session content, never on model requests.

url.description:
Collector base URL (e.g. `https://collector.example.com:4318`).
Empty or absent disables the exporter entirely.

events.description:
Events channel switch (capacity decisions and kin). Default `true`
when the table is present with a `url`.

session_log.description:
Session-log channel switch (byte-capped per-turn summaries).
Default `false`.

disabled.description: Builtin command names (or aliases) to disable.

AutomationsConfig.description:
`[automations]` table — bounds for scheduled automation runs.
Documented in `config.example.toml` + `docs/CLI.md`.

max_steps.description:
Step cap per turn for scheduled (unattended) runs. Defaults to
[`AUTOMATION_DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS`].

SandboxConfigToml.description:
Structured `[sandbox]` table. Every field is optional so legacy flat keys
and per-mode defaults can fill the gaps.

auto_allow.description:
Shell command prefixes that never prompt for approval. Matched by the
same arity dictionary the approval prompt uses
(`command_safety::classify_command`), so `"git status"` covers
`git status -s` and not `git push`. Read at startup; `/permissions`
shows what is in force and `/permissions allow` persists a grant.

RetryConfig.description: Raw retry configuration loaded from config files.

CapacityConfig.description: Capacity-controller config loaded from config files/environment.

default_timeout_secs.description:
Global timeout override. When set it takes precedence over every
hook's `timeout_secs` (table-over-hook precedence, documented in
`docs/HOOKS.md`); when unset, each hook's own timeout applies.

working_dir.description: Working directory for hook execution (default: workspace)

event.description: The event that triggers this hook

command.description: Shell command to execute (platform shell: `sh -c` on Unix, `cmd /C` on Windows)

condition.description: Optional condition for when this hook should run

timeout_secs.description:
Timeout in seconds (default: 30). The executor-level
`default_timeout_secs` override — when set — always takes
precedence over this value (table-over-hook precedence, as
documented in `docs/HOOKS.md`).

background.description: Run in background (don't wait for completion)

continue_on_error.description: Continue if this hook fails (default: true)

HookEvent.description: Events that can trigger hook execution.

oneOf.description:
Immediately before each `exec_shell` invocation. The hook's stdout is
parsed as `KEY=VALUE\n` lines and merged onto the shell command's
environment (#456).

Immediately before context compaction. The hook's stdout is collected
as "context to preserve" and merged into the compaction summary (#485).

After a turn completes (completed / interrupted / failed). Observer-only:
payload carries turn status and usage, stdout is ignored (#1364).
When a sub-agent starts. Observer-only (#1364).
When a sub-agent finishes. Observer-only (#1364).

HookCondition.description: Condition for when a hook should run

oneOf.description: Always run this hook
Only run for specific tool names
Only run for specific tool categories
Only run in specific modes
Only run when exit code matches (for `ToolCallAfter`)
Combine multiple conditions with AND
Combine multiple conditions with OR

custom.description:
Open set of `[[providers.custom]]` entries (ROADMAP §D2). The active
entry is selected by the top-level `Config.custom_provider` id.

vision.description:
Capability override (product-polish §1): does this provider's resolved
model accept inline image content blocks? `None` defers to the static
`provider_capability` model-name matrix. Set `true` for gateways
fronting a vision model the matrix cannot see, `false` to force the
text-reference fallback on a vision-capable model.

display_model.description:
Display-only model name. The REPL prints this string verbatim (banner,
status line, `/status`, `/model`, …) so a gateway alias can be labelled
with what actually serves it. Presentation only: the request payload,
session metadata and logs keep the real `model` id.

context_window.description:
Context-window override in tokens for gateway deployments whose backend
window the static `context_window_for_model` table cannot see. Drives
the status-line 🧭 denominator, `/context` / `/tokens`, and the
auto-compaction threshold. `None` defers to that table.

CustomProviderConfig.description:
Runtime view of a single `[[providers.custom]]` entry (ROADMAP §D2).

Mirrors [`codesmith_config::CustomProviderToml`] but lives in the CLI's own
runtime `Config` schema. Each entry is self-contained (own base_url/model/
credentials); the top-level `Config.custom_provider` selector picks one by
`id`. Selection + resolution is handled by [`Config::custom_provider_entry`]
and `resolve_llm_client`; the builtin accessor path (`api_provider` /
`provider_config_for`) is bypassed for custom providers.

vision.description:
Capability override (product-polish §1); see [`ProviderConfig::vision`].
Custom gateways have no static matrix entry, so the effective default
is `false` (text-reference fallback) unless this is set.

NetworkPolicyToml.description:
`[network]` table — mirrors `codesmith_config::NetworkPolicyToml` so the live
CLI runtime can construct a [`codesmith_agent_runtime::network_policy::NetworkPolicy`]
without reaching into the workspace config crate. See `config.example.toml`
for documentation.

default.description:
Decision for hosts that are not in `allow` or `deny`. One of
`"allow" | "deny" | "prompt"`. Defaults to `"prompt"`.

allow.description:
Hosts that are always allowed. Subdomain rules: a leading dot
(`.example.com`) matches subdomains but not the apex.

deny.description: Hosts that are always denied. Deny entries win over allow entries.

proxy.description:
Hostnames whose DNS may resolve to fake-IP/private proxy ranges in an
explicitly trusted proxy setup. Literal IP URLs remain blocked.

audit.description:
Whether to record one audit-log line per outbound network call.
`None` inherits the active preset's baseline (default `true`).

VerificationToml.description:
`[verification]` table — post-turn claim checks (P3-8). See
`config.example.toml` for documentation.

result_claims.description:
When `true` (the default), a completed turn whose final assistant
message claims "tests pass / build succeeds" triggers an engine-side
re-run of the verification-class command the model executed that
turn; the verdict is injected before the next request and surfaced
as a toast. `false` restores the pre-P3-8 behavior.

DoctorToml.description:
`[doctor]` table — the `codesmith doctor` LLM fallback layer (P3-8
step 2). See `config.example.toml` for documentation.

llm_fallback.description:
When `true` (opt-in; the default is `false`), doctor's post-check
advisory analysis runs when the deterministic checks collected
warnings/errors and an LLM client resolves (utility model when
configured, else the main client). `false` (or unset) keeps doctor
fully deterministic.

SkillsConfig.description: `[skills]` table — knobs for the community-skill installer.

registry_url.description:
Curated registry index. `/skill install <name>` looks up the spec here.
Defaults to [`codesmith_agent_runtime::skills::install::DEFAULT_REGISTRY_URL`].

max_install_size_bytes.description:
Per-skill maximum *uncompressed* size in bytes. Tarballs that exceed
this limit are rejected during validation. Defaults to 5 MiB.

enabled.description:
Snapshot the workspace before and after each interactive agent
turn. `None` inherits the active preset's baseline (default `true`).

max_age_days.description: Prune side-git snapshots older than this many days at session boot.

max_workspace_gb.description:
Maximum non-excluded workspace size (in GB) before the snapshot
feature self-disables on first use. Set to `0` to disable the cap
and snapshot regardless of size (the v0.8.31 behavior). The walk
honors `.gitignore` and the snapshot module's built-in excludes
(`node_modules/`, `target/`, ...) so the measured size reflects
what would actually land in a snapshot commit.

parse_gate.description:
Pre-write parse gate for file-editing tools: writes that would break
a previously-parsing `.rs`/`.toml`/`.json` file are rejected before
touching disk (regression-only — already-broken files stay editable).
`false` restores write-through behavior. `None` inherits the active
preset's baseline (default `true`).

SearchConfig.description: Web search provider configuration (`[search]` table in config.toml).

api_key.description:
API key for Tavily, Bocha, Metaso, Baidu, or Volcengine. Not required for Bing or DuckDuckGo.
Metaso also falls back to `METASO_API_KEY` env var, then a built-in default.
Baidu also falls back to `BAIDU_SEARCH_API_KEY` env var.
Volcengine also falls back to `VOLCENGINE_API_KEY` / `VOLCENGINE_ARK_API_KEY` / `ARK_API_KEY` env vars.

SearchProvider.description: Search provider enumeration — selects which backend `web_search` uses.

oneOf.description: Bing HTML scraping. No API key needed.
DuckDuckGo HTML scraping with Bing fallback. No API key needed.
Tavily AI Search API (<https://tavily.com>). Requires api_key.
Bocha AI Search API (<https://bochaai.com>). Requires api_key.

Metaso AI Search API (<https://metaso.cn>). Uses built-in default key
or `METASO_API_KEY` env var; configurable via `[search] api_key`.
Baidu AI Search API (<https://qianfan.baidubce.com>). Requires api_key.

Volcengine Ark web_search via Responses API. Requires api_key.
Free tier: 20K queries/month per API key. Falls back to
`VOLCENGINE_API_KEY` / `VOLCENGINE_ARK_API_KEY` / `ARK_API_KEY`
env vars when `[search] api_key` is not set.

The active model provider's own server-side search tool
(Anthropic-compatible `web_search_*`). Reuses the provider's
base_url / API key / model, so no `[search] api_key` is needed.

enabled.description:
Master switch. `None` means enabled (default-on when a backend is
compiled in), so the index costs nothing to adopt.

refresh_budget_ms.description:
Wall-clock budget for the lazy incremental refresh a single query
may trigger. Default: [`DEFAULT_REFRESH_BUDGET_MS`]. `0` is not a
valid "disable": [`IndexConfig::effective_refresh_budget_ms`]
floors it to 1 ms — disable the index to turn the refresh off.

IndexFilesConfig.description:
`[index.files]` — file inventory cache. Built-in walk (`ignore` crate),
no swappable backend, so the table only carries a switch.

backend.description:
Registry id of the extraction backend. Default:
[`DEFAULT_SYMBOLS_BACKEND`].

languages.description: Per-language switches; an absent language key means enabled.

IndexLanguages.description:
`[index.symbols.languages]` — one boolean per language, all `Option`
with enabled defaults. Unknown keys are rejected: a mistyped or
not-yet-supported language name (`kotlin = true`) silently falling back
to "not configured" contradicts the fail-fast validation goal.

IndexSemanticConfig.description:
`[index.semantic]` — reserved seam for embedding-based search. No
built-in backend this cycle; enabling it with no capable backend fails
[`IndexConfig::validate`].

backend.description: Registry id of the semantic backend. Default `"none"`.

MemoryConfig.description:
User-level memory configuration (#489).

Default is **on** (mirrors Claude Code's `isAutoMemoryEnabled`): when this
table is absent, the memory file is read/written and `# foo` quick-adds in
the composer append to it. The effective enablement is resolved by
[`Config::memory_enabled`], which applies a five-level priority cascade
(disable env > bare/simple > remote-without-storage > explicit setting >
default on). Set `enabled = false` (or `CODESMITH_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY=1`) to
opt out.

enabled.description:
When `true`, load the user memory file at `Config::memory_path()`
into the system prompt as a `<user_memory>` block, and intercept
`# foo` typed in the composer to append to that file. When `None`,
the cascade default (`true`) applies.

kod_enabled.description:
When `true`, evolve memory from a single file to a directory-based
Knowledge On Demand system with frontmatter-parsed `.md` files,
an entrypoint (`MEMORY.md`), and async prefetch per turn.
Requires `enabled = true` and the `knowledge_on_demand` feature flag.

directory.description:
Override path for the memory directory. When unset, defaults to
the parent of `Config::memory_path()` with `/memory/` appended.

excludes.description:
Paths to exclude from the four-tier CLAUDE.md memory merge (Plan 03 /
finding F1). Each entry is `~`/env-expanded and canonicalized before
matching, so a symlinked or realpath-variant of an excluded file is
dropped too. Resolved into the `CODESMITH_MEMORY_EXCLUDES` env var at
engine startup so every load site (per-turn prompt reloader, session
init, …) honours it without threading `EngineConfig`.

AutoConfig.description:
`[auto]` table — knobs for the `--model auto` / `/model auto` router.

`cost_saving` (#1207): the full cheap-routing opt-in. When `true`, the
router classifier runs on the configured `[utility_model]` (cheap brain)
and ambiguous requests resolve to the light tier. Default `false`: the
classifier runs on the heavy tier — the strongest available brain decides
who does the work — and ambiguous requests resolve to heavy.

heavy_model.description:
Explicit heavy-tier model for auto routing. Wins over the provider's
default heavy model; the only way to pin the heavy tier on
pass-through providers (custom gateways, OpenAI-compatible endpoints)
whose catalogue the router cannot infer.

light_model.description:
Explicit light-tier model for auto routing. Wins over the provider's
default light model (see `Config::resolve_model_tier`).

router_model.description:
Explicit model for the routing classifier itself. Default: the heavy
tier. `[auto] cost_saving = true` moves the classifier to the
`[utility_model]` cheap brain instead.

LspConfigToml.description:
`[lsp]` table — mirrors [`crate::lsp::LspConfig`]. Documented in
`config.example.toml`. When omitted, defaults from `LspConfig::default()`
apply (enabled, 5 s poll, 20 diagnostics/file, errors only, no overrides).

poll_after_edit_ms.description:
How long to wait for the LSP server to publish diagnostics after a
`didOpen`/`didChange`. Defaults to 5000 ms.

max_diagnostics_per_file.description: Cap on diagnostics surfaced per file. Defaults to 20.

include_warnings.description: Whether to surface warnings in addition to errors. Defaults to `false`.

servers.description:
Optional override for the `Language -> [cmd, ...args]` table. Keys
are language slugs (`"rust"`, `"go"`, etc.).

ContextConfig.description: Context management configuration (append-only layered context with Flash seams).

enabled.description:
Master enable for layered context management. Default: false while
v0.7.5 audits V4 prefix-cache behavior.

project_pack.description:
Include a deterministic project context pack in the stable prompt
prefix. Default: true; set `[context] project_pack = false` to disable.

verbatim_window_turns.description: Verbatim window: last N turns never summarized. Default: 16.

l1_threshold.description: Soft seam thresholds based on the active request input estimate.

seam_model.description: Model used for seam/briefing work. Default: "deepseek-v4-flash".

tokenizer_path.description:
Path to a HuggingFace `tokenizer.json` (e.g. DeepSeek's) used for
exact token counts across compaction, capacity, and truncation
budgets. When unset (or on load failure) the chars/3 heuristic
estimate is used. Download e.g.:
`huggingface-cli download deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3 tokenizer.json
--local-dir ~/.codesmith/tokenizers`

SubagentsConfig.description:
Sub-agent model overrides. Keys in `models` can be role names (`worker`,
`explorer`, `awaiter`) or type names (`general`, `explore`, `plan`,
`review`, `custom`). Per-call explicit model choices still win.

max_concurrent.description:
Maximum concurrent sub-agents. Overrides the top-level max_subagents
setting. Clamped to [1, MAX_SUBAGENTS].

api_timeout_secs.description:
Per-step DeepSeek API timeout for sub-agent requests, in seconds. The
timeout wraps `client.create_message` so a stuck single step cannot
pin the parent's parent-completion wakeup channel indefinitely.
Defaults to `DEFAULT_SUBAGENT_API_TIMEOUT_SECS` (120) and is clamped
to `MIN_SUBAGENT_API_TIMEOUT_SECS..=MAX_SUBAGENT_API_TIMEOUT_SECS`
(1..=1800). Zero or unset uses the legacy 120s default (#1806, #1808).

inherit_full_registry.description:
Whether sub-agents inherit the FULL parent tool registry regardless of
the parent's effective tool set (legacy v0.6.6 behavior). Default
`false` (Plan 04 / finding F4 `restrictToSubset`): a child's tool
surface is a subset of its parent's effective tools — children can
never escalate beyond what the parent exposes. Set `true` to restore
unrestricted full inheritance for flows that relied on the old default.

external_provider.description:
Out-of-process sub-agent provider. Unset (default) runs children
in-process; `"headless"` runs each non-team child as a
`codesmith exec --json` subprocess of this binary (see
`tools::subagent::headless`); `"acp"` delegates each run to an
Agent-Client-Protocol stdio agent configured under
`[subagents.acp]` (see `tools::subagent::acp`). Unknown names are
rejected at config load.

AcpSubagentConfig.description: `[subagents.acp]` — how to spawn and bound the ACP child agent.

command.description: Executable to spawn (required for the `acp` provider).

env.description: Extra environment variables layered over the parent's environment.

timeout_secs.description:
Child-run timeout in seconds. Unset uses 1800 (30 min, matching the
headless provider); values below 1 clamp to 1.

RuntimeConfig.description:
`[runtime]` table — engine-wide limits shared by every engine root
(REPL, `exec`, automation threads). The sub-agent depth-gate error
("Increase via [runtime] max_spawn_depth in config.toml") points here.

max_spawn_depth.description:
Maximum sub-agent spawn depth across the whole spawn tree
(`spawn_depth + 1 > max_spawn_depth` rejects). Unset falls back to
[`crate::tools::subagent::DEFAULT_MAX_SPAWN_DEPTH`] (3); `0`
disables sub-agent spawning entirely. A headless child inherits the
*remaining* budget through `CODESMITH_SUBAGENT_DEPTH` /
`CODESMITH_MAX_SPAWN_DEPTH`, which takes precedence over this value
inside the child.

WorkflowConfig.description:
`[workflow]` table — bounds for the model-writable `workflow` tool.

Unknown keys inside the table fail at load (`deny_unknown_fields`,
the fail-loud serde posture; see `crates/config/src/presets.rs` for the
precedent) and out-of-range values fail `validate` at startup — never a
silent clamp.

timeout_secs.description:
Wall-clock bound for one workflow run, in seconds. Default
[`codesmith_agent_runtime::workflow::DEFAULT_WORKFLOW_TIMEOUT_SECS`]
(600); values of 0 or above
[`codesmith_agent_runtime::workflow::MAX_WORKFLOW_TIMEOUT_SECS`]
(1800) are rejected at load.

RuntimeApiConfig.description: `[runtime_api]` table — knobs for the local HTTP/SSE daemon.

cors_origins.description:
Additional CORS origins to allow on top of the built-in defaults
(`http://localhost:{3000,1420}`, `http://127.0.0.1:{3000,1420}`,
`tauri://localhost`). Useful when developing a UI against a non-default
dev server port (e.g. Vite's default `:5173`).

Resolution order (highest priority first): `--cors-origin` CLI flag,
`CODESMITH_CORS_ORIGINS` env var (comma-separated), this field. Whalescale#255 / #561.

large_output_threshold_tokens.description:
Token threshold above which tool results are routed through the workshop
synthesis sub-agent. Default: [`DEFAULT_LARGE_OUTPUT_THRESHOLD_TOKENS`].

per_tool_thresholds.description:
Per-tool threshold overrides (tool name → token limit). A tool whose
name appears here uses this limit instead of
`large_output_threshold_tokens`.

VisionModelConfig.description:
Vision model configuration for the `image_analyze` tool.
Uses an OpenAI-compatible vision model API.

api_key.description: API key for the vision model. Inherits from main config if not specified.

base_url.description: Base URL for the vision model API. Defaults to OpenAI.

UtilityModelConfig.description:
Utility model configuration — a cheap/fast secondary LLM for background
assists (workshop large-output synthesis #548, auto-route classification,
Flash seams). When the table is absent every assist falls back to the main
model and behaviour is unchanged.

model.description:
Model identifier (e.g., "deepseek-v4-flash"). Setting the table
enables the utility model.

provider.description:
Provider for the utility model. Inherits the main provider when unset;
a different provider here builds a dedicated second client.

api_key.description: API key for the utility model. Inherits from main config if not specified.

base_url.description: Base URL for the utility model. Inherits from main config if not specified.

Config.description: Resolved CLI configuration, including defaults and environment overrides.

custom_provider.description:
Active custom provider id (ROADMAP §D2). When set, this overrides
`provider` and selects the matching `[[providers.custom]]` entry by id.
The host maps this to `ProviderId::Custom(id)` for `resolve_llm_client`.

turn_executor.description:
Selected main-turn executor id (kernel composition,
`engine::executor_composition`). Kept as a raw string because the id
space is open: the always-present `builtin` plus any factory a host
registers on the process-shared turn-executor registry. An unknown id
fails loud at startup.

http_headers.description: Optional extra HTTP headers sent to model API requests.

reasoning_effort.description:
DeepSeek reasoning-effort tier: `"off" | "low" | "medium" | "high" | "max"`.
Defaults to `"max"` at runtime if unset.

tools.description:
Native tool catalog controls. `tools_file` is the legacy external
schema path; this table controls built-in tool loading policy.

strict_tool_mode.description:
When true, set `tool_choice: "required"` and opt compatible function
schemas into DeepSeek beta strict mode. Schemas with root alternatives
stay non-strict to avoid changing optional/one-of tool semantics.

instructions.description:
Additional system-prompt sources concatenated in declared order
(#454). Paths are expanded via `expand_path` so `~` and env
vars work. Project config overrides user config (replace, not
merge) — that's the typical "this repo needs X plus everything
I already have" pattern, where users put `~/global.md` in the
project's array if they want both. Each file is loaded, capped
at 100 KiB, and skipped (with a warning) on read errors so a
missing optional file doesn't fail the launch.

system_prompt.description:
Full system prompt override. Replaces the built-in assembled prompt but
still preserves explicit append sections after it.

system_prompt_file.description: Path to a file containing the full system prompt override.

append_system_prompt.description: Additional system-prompt append sources rendered after the selected base.

personality.description:
Personality overlay for the system prompt: `"calm"` (default) or
`"playful"`. Case-insensitive; invalid values fail `validate` at
startup so typos surface immediately instead of silently falling
back to calm. Presentation-only — voice and tone, never behavior.

preset.description:
Active configuration preset tier (`simple` | `middle` | `all` |
`experiment`, plus `plan` and user/project preset files). Preset
values are *baselines* applied fill-if-unset after profile and
project merging: explicit keys elsewhere in this file always win,
and any explicit value that differs from the selected tier turns
the effective preset into `diy` (a derived state — see
[`Config::effective_preset`]). Overridden by `--preset` on the CLI.

mode.description:
Deprecated pre-rename alias of [`Self::preset`]; still accepted so
existing configs keep working (canonicalized with a warning).

telemetry.description:
Enable local-only telemetry: capacity-decision analytics events are
written to `~/.codesmith/telemetry/events.jsonl`. Off by default; the
sink is constructed pre-trust (events queue in-memory) and only
attaches (writes to disk) once the workspace trust boundary passes.

telemetry_otlp.description:
OTLP/HTTP telemetry export (`[telemetry_otlp]`). Opt-in and
default-off: absent table (or empty `url`) means the exporter is
never constructed — zero network. See `docs/CONFIGURATION.md`.

mods.description:
Script Mods (§F script mod layer) controls: `enabled` gates the whole
script-mod layer (discovery, `manage_mods` tool, watcher), `watch`
gates only the hot-reload file watcher. Both default to `true`.
Documented in `config.example.toml` + `docs/MODS.md`.

commands.description:
Built-in slash-command controls (`[commands] disabled`): canonical
names or aliases of builtin commands to hide — dispatch, `/help`,
and Tab completion all skip them, while user commands and mod
commands of the same name still work. Validated against the builtin
table at REPL start (an unknown name fails loud). Documented in
`config.example.toml` + `docs/CLI.md`.

automations.description:
Bounds for scheduled automation runs (`[automations] max_steps`).
Defaults to [`AUTOMATION_DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS`] — see
[`AutomationsConfig`].

sandbox_backend.description:
External sandbox backend: `"none"` or `"opensandbox"`.
When set, exec_shell routes commands through the backend's HTTP API
instead of spawning a local process.

sandbox_url.description: Base URL for the external sandbox backend (default: `"http://localhost:8080"`).

sandbox_api_key.description: Optional API key for the external sandbox backend (sent as Bearer token).

sandbox.description:
Optional structured sandbox controls. Legacy top-level sandbox fields are
still accepted and are merged into the runtime view for compatibility.

prefer_bwrap.description:
When true and `/usr/bin/bwrap` is present on Linux, route exec_shell
through bubblewrap instead of relying solely on Landlock (#2184).
Defaults to false. Requires the `bubblewrap` package to be installed
separately — we do NOT vendor bwrap.

stream_idle_timeout_secs.description:
Idle watchdog for streaming responses, in seconds: the maximum
silence between two consecutive stream events before the stream is
declared silently stalled and aborted into the transparent-retry path
(P0-1). Default 120; `0` disables the watchdog; clamped to
`[MIN_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECS, MAX_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECS]`
(10..=3600) otherwise.

stream_idle_retry_increment_secs.description:
Per-retry widening of the stream idle watchdog window, in seconds:
each transparent retry's idle deadline grows by this amount times the
retries already spent, so a provider silence gap longer than the base
window doesn't kill every retry in the same silent stretch (P0-1
adaptive retry). Default 30; `0` keeps the window fixed; clamped to
`[0, MAX_STREAM_IDLE_RETRY_INCREMENT_SECS]` (600) otherwise.

providers.description: Provider-specific credentials and defaults shared with the `codesmith` facade.

network.description:
Per-domain network policy (#135). When absent, network tools fall back
to a permissive default, matching the old lenient behavior.

verification.description:
Post-turn claim checks (P3-8). When absent, the result claim
verifier runs with its defaults (on).

doctor.description:
`codesmith doctor` LLM fallback layer (P3-8). When absent, the
advisory analysis runs with its default (on, when findings exist
and a client resolves).

skills.description:
Community skill installer settings (#140). When absent, installer
commands fall back to the bundled defaults
([`codesmith_agent_runtime::skills::install::DEFAULT_REGISTRY_URL`] +
[`codesmith_agent_runtime::skills::install::DEFAULT_MAX_SIZE_BYTES`]).

snapshots.description:
Workspace side-git snapshots (#137). Defaults to enabled with 7-day
retention when the table is absent.

edit.description:
File-editing behavior (P0-1 parse gate). Defaults to enabled when
the table is absent.

search.description:
Web search provider configuration. When absent, defaults to DuckDuckGo.
Set `provider` to `bing`, `tavily`, or `bocha` to use those services
instead; Tavily and Bocha also require an `api_key`.

memory.description:
User-level memory file (#489). Default behaviour is **opt-in**:
loading + injection happens only when `[memory] enabled = true` or
`CODESMITH_MEMORY=on` is set.

auto.description:
Tunables for `--model auto` (#1207). When absent, the auto router
keeps its existing balanced behaviour.

lsp.description:
Post-edit LSP diagnostics injection (#136). When absent, the engine
applies the defaults documented in [`LspConfigToml`].

context.description: Append-only layered context management with Flash seam manager (#159).

runtime.description:
Engine recursion limits (`[runtime]` table). When absent, the
documented defaults apply.

workflow.description:
Bounds for the model-writable `workflow` tool (`[workflow]`
table). When absent, the documented defaults apply.

runtime_api.description:
Runtime API server tuning (`codesmith serve --http`). Currently only
hosts the CORS allow-list extension (whalescale#255 / #561). When the
table is absent, the daemon ships with localhost:3000 / localhost:1420
/ tauri://localhost as the only allowed dev origins.

workshop.description:
Workshop / large-tool-output routing (#548). When absent, the global
default threshold of 4 096 tokens applies and routing is active.

vision_model.description: Vision model configuration for the `image_analyze` tool.

utility_model.description:
Utility model configuration — a cheap/fast secondary LLM for background
assists (workshop large-output synthesis, auto-route classification,
Flash seams). When absent, all assists use the main model.
